verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel (system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs) is a fair question for a state business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing all-agent crawl bans on the SCC and CIS hosts and a named GPTBot ban at Virginia Tax. Nothing documents a programmatic transaction channel or an enrollment path, and crawl posture is not evidence either way about such a program.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
